frozen_source.source_change_rule: The execution revision must descend from parent_revision with no changes under sle, scripts, tests, benchmarks, or requirements-upstream.txt. Research and experiment evidence commits are allowed.

model_condition.replicate_identifier_limit: The single local seed controls only local ordering; it is not a provider generation seed and supports no population inference.

feedback_semantics.normal: Later proposals see the true-score-selected incumbent and only allowlisted public metrics.
feedback_semantics.selection_blind: Every proposal sees the frozen baseline and baseline allowlisted metrics; proposal scores are used only for offline best-of-batch selection.

evaluation_questions.scientific_application: Does the task implement a recognizable scientific design, inference, discovery, or instrument workflow rather than a generic objective with scientific naming?
evaluation_questions.professional_knowledge: Does success require domain equations, experimental design, numerical analysis, uncertainty, mechanism, or physical constraints beyond generic code search?
evaluation_questions.scientific_tools: Does the task naturally exercise simulation, inverse methods, dynamic programming, signal processing, optimization, statistical inference, or equivalent scientific tools?
evaluation_questions.difficulty_and_discrimination: Are GPT-5.6-sol outcomes nontrivial, non-saturated, and separated by task or condition while retaining valid headroom?
evaluation_questions.self_evolving_fit: Can iterative artifact revision and evaluator feedback produce measurable improvement without exposing sealed science metrics, and is the result distinct from open-loop best-of-batch generation?

predeclared_descriptive_gates.protocol_health: All 8 cells complete with no provider or evaluator infrastructure failure and all 24 scheduled proposal events retained.
predeclared_descriptive_gates.challenge: At least two tasks have best combined_score below 0.95 and at least one task below 0.50; a zero score counts as challenge only when at least one executable proposal was valid or a concrete proposal-failure hurdle is retained.
predeclared_descriptive_gates.discrimination: Across the four task-level best scores, the range is at least 0.10 and at least two distinct 0.10-wide score bands are occupied, or proposal-validity rates differ by at least 0.25 across tasks.
predeclared_descriptive_gates.short_horizon_self_evolution_signal: Report normal minus selection-blind and post-first-valid gains by task. Any apparent gain is descriptive only because each condition has one unseeded provider draw.
predeclared_descriptive_gates.anti_saturation: No more than two of four tasks may achieve best score at or above 0.95 in this pilot.

leakage_and_failure_policy.runtime_allowed: Task.md, public constraints, baseline source, and the closed allowlist of feasibility/selection metrics.
leakage_and_failure_policy.runtime_prohibited: Certification status, broad discipline, historical GPT-5.5 outcomes, task-card review labels, evaluator-only science metrics, held-out labels, ground truth, and score files.
leakage_and_failure_policy.offline_only: Task selection rationale, task-card evidence, GPT-5.5 comparison, science-axis decomposition, and category grouping occur only after GPT-5.6 predictions are complete.
leakage_and_failure_policy.failure_retention: Invalid code, schema failures, runtime failures, timeouts, and outer provider failures remain outcomes; do not silently replace them or relabel a valid-only cohort.
leakage_and_failure_policy.stopping: Run all eight frozen cells unless endpoint or evaluator infrastructure prevents continuation; do not stop because scores look good, bad, saturated, or favorable to a hypothesis.
